patch_description: Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic maximin search in barycentric coordinates. The three vertices are retained as anchors, while the remaining eight points are optimized using repeated seeded restarts, bottleneck-focused simulated annealing, and a final decreasing-step local polish. Barycentric coordinates make feasibility inexpensive and exact: clipping followed by normalization always returns a point inside the equilateral triangle. The objective is the minimum absolute barycentric determinant over all triples, which is precisely triangle area normalized by the area of the containing equilateral triangle.
